text:
maria: Quick q — compliance asked for 'rollback evidence' export: do we provide full resource snapshots or just diffs + signatures? cc @kevin @sara
aj: my vote: minimal diffs + signed prev-state refs. full snapshots are huge for larger tenants and slow to generate.
kevin: agree on size. for subpoenas/legal we sometimes need full before/after. proposal: diffs by default, full snapshots behind an opt-in that requires justification/approval.
sara: security: full snapshots often contain PII. we need configurable redaction levels and enforced approvals. also require KMS/HSM-signed manifests for chain-of-custody.
maria: product wants a simple console flow — 'Request evidence' button that starts an export job, shows ETA, and logs requester + approver.
aj: implementation sketch: export job produces an NDJSON change stream + signed manifest. optional encrypted snapshot bundle when include_snapshots=true. example manifest snippet:
```
manifest.json {
  "job_id": "...",
  "files": [{"path":"diffs.ndjson","sha256":"..."}],
  "signer": "kms:arn:..."
}
```
kevin: API shape idea: POST /v1/audit_exports {range, tenant_id, include_snapshots: bool, reason: string} -> returns job_id; GET /v1/audit_exports/{id}/download for bundle.
sara: require 'justification' and 'approver' fields when include_snapshots=true. tie to policy engine to enforce review and retention limits (e.g., max retention for snapshots).
maria: UX notes: modal should show estimated size/cost, suggested retention, and a redaction level dropdown (none/min/PII-only). include checkbox: "include full snapshot (requires approval)" with tooltip.
aj: telemetry/cost tracking: emit events audit.export.requested, audit.export.started, audit.export.completed, audit.export.downloaded, audit.export.size_bytes. log estimate vs actual size for cost alerts.
kevin: operationally we need per-tenant export quotas and throttles (default e.g., 5GB/day). quota service + billing hook. also route heavy exports to cold-storage nodes so we don't affect hot-serving capacity.
sara: for forensics keep the export manifest signed and provide a verify endpoint that checks signatures + file hashes. webhook alert to security on include_snapshots approvals and downloads.
maria: next steps: draft API spec + console mock + telemetry schema. @aj can you prototype manifest layout? @kevin add quota/enforcement plan. @sara write redaction checklist and approval flow.
aj: :thumbsup: I'll prototype a manifest and a sample export job PR in the eng-platform RFC repo.
ops-bot: created issue #1243 for "audit exports: snapshots opt-in flow" — assignees: aj, kevin, sara
kevin: I'll add quota/config knobs to the routing/policy service so exports get scheduled on cold nodes and respect tenant limits.
